sqlMap.update: INSERT INTO KMOBILE.LETTAPPNOTI (NOTI_ID, BOARD_ID, BLTN_NO, TITLE, BODY, LINK_URL, REG_DT) SELECT KMOBILE.SEQ_LETTAPPNOTI.NEXTVAL, #boardId#, #bltnNo#, #title#, #body#, #linkUrl#, SYSDATE FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM KMOBILE.LETTAPPNOTI WHERE BOARD_ID = #boardId# AND BLTN_NO = #bltnNo# )
sqlMap.select:
SELECT B.BOARD_ID , TO_CHAR(B.BLTN_NO) AS BLTN_NO , B.BLTN_SUBJ , F.BOARD_NM FROM BULLETIN B JOIN BOARD_LANG F ON B.BOARD_ID = F.BOARD_ID AND F.LANG_KND = 'ko' WHERE B.BOARD_ID IN
#boardIds[]#
AND B.DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND B.BLTN_PERMIT_YN = 'Y' AND B.BLTN_SECRET_YN = 'N' AND B.REG_DATIM > SYSDATE - 1 AND ( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(B.BLTN_BGN_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(B.BLTN_END_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') OR (B.BLTN_BGN_YMD IS NULL AND B.BLTN_END_YMD IS NULL) ) ORDER BY B.REG_DATIM
SELECT TOKEN FROM LETTAPPTOKEN WHERE ( (#pushType# = 'EVENT' AND PUSH_EVENT_YN = 'Y') OR (#pushType# = 'BOARD' AND PUSH_BOARD_YN = 'Y') )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KMOBILE.LETTAPPNOTI SET SEND_DT = SYSDATE , SEND_CNT = #sendCnt# , FAIL_CNT = #failCnt# WHERE BOARD_ID = #boardId# AND BLTN_NO = #bltnNo#
sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, TB.* FROM ( SELECT NOTI_ID , TITLE , BODY , LINK_URL , TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REG_DT FROM KMOBILE.LETTAPPNOTI WHERE SEND_DT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NOTI_ID DESC ) TB ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #pageIndex# AND (#pageIndex# - 1) + #pageSize#
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KMOBILE.LETTAPPNOTI WHERE SEND_DT IS NOT NULL
SELECT NVL(MAX(PUSH_EVENT_YN), 'N') AS PUSH_EVENT_YN , NVL(MAX(PUSH_BOARD_YN), 'N') AS PUSH_BOARD_YN FROM LETTAPPTOKEN WHERE TOKEN = #token#
sqlMap.update:
MERGE INTO LETTAPPTOKEN t USING DUAL ON ( t.TOKEN = #token# ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
t.PUSH_EVENT_YN = #pushYn#
t.PUSH_BOARD_YN = #pushYn#
, t.UPDT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TOKEN, PUSH_EVENT_YN, PUSH_BOARD_YN, REGDT ) VALUES ( #token#
, #pushYn#, 'N'
, 'N', #pushYn#
, SYSDATE )
